note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling in Fermanagh took place on Wednesday 3 June 1936 and the results were declared on Thursday 4 June. The Monea division was the only contest in this district. The other twenty-five divisions were filled unopposed at the nominations; their members are named in the Impartial Reporter of 7 May 1936, p. 7 (added 6 Nov 2026). Filed on 1936-06-03, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (provisional); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Elliott, a Unionist, defeated the independent John Connor, who had also lost his county council seat for Monea in the same election. Majority 64. The new rural council consisted of 19 Unionists and nine Nationalists.
